title: Search results don't change after initial results after you use a keyboard shortcut to open a menu
line: Global Menu's Search opens empty again and keeps filtering after you close it and open another menu with Alt+F.
explanation: The full-view Global Menu shows every menu in one shared popup, and to do that it moved the app's actions out of their menu into the popup, only moving them back when a different menu was opened. After closing Search and opening a menu with Alt+F, the search kept inserting and removing results in a menu that was no longer the one on screen, so the popup showed old results that typing never changed. The popup now adds the same actions while leaving them in the app's menu and follows that menu's changes while open; the search field is created per popup showing it, and closing it clears the results.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: Show menus in the popup without taking their actions

The popup moved the app's actions into itself, so the search kept
editing a menu nobody saw and its results went stale. Add the actions
while they stay in the app's menu, and clear the search on closing it.

BUG: 527154

media.caption: Master: Search reopened after clo, Esc, Alt+F, Esc: the field is empty but the old results are still listed
Fix: Search reopens empty, with no leftover results

Fix: typing new lists New Window and New Tab
Master: Search clo, Esc, Alt+F, Esc, Search again: stale results
